node: AI data-center power equipment, grid interconnection, and electrical construction
summary: Underfollowed expansion for the AI data-center power/interconnection node points to niche electrical equipment and specialty construction vendors rather than hyperscalers or mega-cap power leaders. Reference leaders such as Vertiv, Eaton, GE Vernova and Quanta remain important context anchors, but this pass prioritizes less obvious US-listed suppliers with switchgear, electrical contracting, modular power, cable-management, liquid-cooling, power-distribution, and construction-execution exposure. The cleanest evidence in this pass is company-disclosed data-center demand/backlog at Powell Industries and IES Holdings. nVent has strong product-level exposure but is now a larger, more recognized electrification/data-center asset. Atkore is a lower-attention second-order electrical-products supplier with plausible but less quantified data-center exposure.
